title: Normal and periodic tracking area updating procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to update tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to reject tracking area updating request from UE.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for rejection in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message.

entities.name: Extended EMM cause
entities.description: Additional cause information for EMM cause values.

entities.name: T3346 value
entities.description: Timer value for back-off timer T3346 included in reject message.

entities.name: T3430
entities.description: Timer for tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is not registered with network.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with network.

entities.name: Integrity protected message
entities.description: Condition where NAS message has integrity protection.

entities.name: UE stops user data transmission
entities.description: Behavior where UE stops transmitting user data upon receiving reject message.

relations.description: Tracking area updating procedure includes sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message when rejected.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message contains EMM cause IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message may contain T3346 value IE.
Upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT, UE stops timer T3430.
Receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT causes UE to stop user data transmission.
UE starts timer T3346 when T3346 value IE is present in reject message.
UE behavior depends on whether TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT is integrity protected.
Specific EMM cause values cause UE to enter EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Specific EMM cause values cause UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED state.
Extended EMM cause IE may be included with specific EMM cause values.
